name: ibis Saigon Airport
short_description: A 4-star ibis 5 minutes' walk from Tan Son Nhat International Airport, with 273 rooms and serviced apartments and a rooftop sky bar overlooking the airport, holding a 4.5/5 ALL Rating (1,848 reviews).
ai_summary: ibis Saigon Airport sits a 5-minute walk from Tan Son Nhat International Airport in Ho Chi Minh City's Tan Binh District. The 4-star hotel has 273 rooms including standard rooms, studios, and one/two-bedroom serviced apartments with kitchenettes for long-term rental. Bistro by Oopen serves all-day local and international dining, and The Hub Saigon rooftop bar overlooks the airport with cocktails and drinks. The property holds a strong 4.5/5 ALL Rating from 1,848 reviews on its own Accor page. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
